about: Arousal detection: one binary probe per threshold, positive when the epoch holds more than that many seconds of scored arousal (0, 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9 s; sleep_arousal reports 3 s).
_doc: Arousal detection. Thresholds are seconds of arousal per epoch. On MASS the benchmark uses the mass_arousal preset (subset SS01, the only one with arousal annotations).
